plugins.name: fly
plugins.description: Ship the current work as a pull request with every local check green — reads the repo's CHECKS.md, runs the checks, fixes what breaks, commits, pushes, and opens or updates the PR. Does not wait on CI.

plugins.name: shape-it
plugins.description: Plan a piece of work by reading the project first, saying in plain words what it is and what skipping it costs, then asking only what is expensive to reverse. Batched multiple-choice questions, then a markdown plan opened for annotation in plannotator. `shape-it` reads and writes DOMAIN.md and docs/decisions/ so answers outlive the plan; `shape-it-lite` is the same procedure without them, for repos that carry neither. Ships `domain` and the manual-only `domain-adopt`. Does not enter plan mode and does not implement.
